user_goal.text: Buy Eric Bailey any Amazon sweater in his size, determine that size from a past sweater order, and assure from QAs/reviews that nobody reported its color fading after washing.

benchmark_success.rationale: TestTracker succeeds exactly when all nine registered tests pass.

checked_by.text: The frozen AppWorld TestTracker evaluator checks the parsed task answer and the pre-run/end-state model changes through nine registered tests.

decisive_artifacts.question: Does the result show success true with all nine registered tests passed and no registered failures?

decisive_artifacts.artifact: Post-run supervisor task answer and pre-run/end-state model diff
decisive_artifacts.question: Does the parsed answer equal null, and do the changed models and records satisfy every official order, product, quantity, size, name, address-text, and address-mutation comparison?

success_if.text: [appworld_test_001_844d21b309f0] passes exactly when this official requirement is satisfied: assert answers match.
success_if.rationale: The evaluator parses the retained task answer and compares it with the official null answer.

success_if.text: [appworld_test_002_15bbd8b2ab15] passes exactly when this official requirement is satisfied: assert model changes match amazon.Order, amazon.Product, ignoring amazon.CartEntry, file_system.Directory, amazon.Address.
success_if.rationale: The evaluator compares the changed-model-name set after applying its explicit ignore list.

success_if.text: [appworld_test_003_220625a92985] passes exactly when this official requirement is satisfied: assert there is 1 new amazon.Order using models.changed_records.
success_if.rationale: The evaluator requires exactly one added Amazon order in the model diff.

success_if.text: [appworld_test_004_62d2fa85384c] passes exactly when this official requirement is satisfied: assert this new order has 1 quantity of a single product.
success_if.rationale: The evaluator requires one order item whose ordered quantity is one.

success_if.text: [appworld_test_005_4e88cc8ed3e9] passes exactly when this official requirement is satisfied: assert the ordered product is of type data.public.apparel_type.
success_if.rationale: The ordered product type must equal the official public apparel type, sweater.

success_if.text: [appworld_test_006_627d26d0000f] passes exactly when this official requirement is satisfied: assert the ordered product has relative_size data.private.selected_relative_size.
success_if.rationale: The ordered product's relative size must equal the official selected size, large.

success_if.text: [appworld_test_007_57d07ed530e1] passes exactly when this official requirement is satisfied: assert the ordered product is the one with data.private.selected_product_name.
success_if.rationale: The ordered product name must equal the official selected product name.

success_if.text: [appworld_test_008_b8c785848138] passes exactly when this official requirement is satisfied: assert the order's address text is main_user.home_address.text (normalize_text=True)
success_if.rationale: The new order's address text must equal the main user's home address after text normalization.

success_if.text: [appworld_test_009_74c9e9d0aa82] passes exactly when this official requirement is satisfied: assert 0 records have been updated or deleted from amazon.Address using models.changed_records.
success_if.rationale: The Amazon address diff must contain no updated or deleted records.

fail_if.text: [appworld_test_001_844d21b309f0] fails exactly when this official requirement is not satisfied: assert answers match.
fail_if.rationale: A parsed task answer unequal to the official null answer fails this registered test.

fail_if.text: [appworld_test_002_15bbd8b2ab15] fails exactly when this official requirement is not satisfied: assert model changes match amazon.Order, amazon.Product, ignoring amazon.CartEntry, file_system.Directory, amazon.Address.
fail_if.rationale: A changed-model-name set unequal to the evaluator's expected set fails this registered test.

fail_if.text: [appworld_test_003_220625a92985] fails exactly when this official requirement is not satisfied: assert there is 1 new amazon.Order using models.changed_records.
fail_if.rationale: Any added-order count other than one fails this registered test.

fail_if.text: [appworld_test_004_62d2fa85384c] fails exactly when this official requirement is not satisfied: assert this new order has 1 quantity of a single product.
fail_if.rationale: More or fewer than one order item, or an ordered quantity other than one, fails this registered test.

fail_if.text: [appworld_test_005_4e88cc8ed3e9] fails exactly when this official requirement is not satisfied: assert the ordered product is of type data.public.apparel_type.
fail_if.rationale: A product type other than the official public apparel type fails this registered test.

fail_if.text: [appworld_test_006_627d26d0000f] fails exactly when this official requirement is not satisfied: assert the ordered product has relative_size data.private.selected_relative_size.
fail_if.rationale: A relative size other than the official selected size fails this registered test.

fail_if.text: [appworld_test_007_57d07ed530e1] fails exactly when this official requirement is not satisfied: assert the ordered product is the one with data.private.selected_product_name.
fail_if.rationale: A product name other than the official selected product name fails this registered test.

fail_if.text: [appworld_test_008_b8c785848138] fails exactly when this official requirement is not satisfied: assert the order's address text is main_user.home_address.text (normalize_text=True)
fail_if.rationale: Address text unequal to the main user's normalized home-address text fails this registered test.

fail_if.text: [appworld_test_009_74c9e9d0aa82] fails exactly when this official requirement is not satisfied: assert 0 records have been updated or deleted from amazon.Address using models.changed_records.
fail_if.rationale: Any updated or deleted Amazon address record fails this registered test.

undecided_if.text: Undecided only if retained evidence cannot determine one or more frozen registered-test outcomes.
undecided_if.rationale: A registered-test outcome must not be inferred when its decisive retained evidence is missing or non-decisive.

additional_conditions.text: Beyond the native checks, retained Amazon product evidence for the ordered sweater must show that its QAs/reviews contain no report of color fading after washing.
additional_conditions.rationale: The user explicitly requests assurance from QAs/reviews, while the released evaluator checks a fixed product name but does not inspect retained Q&A/review evidence.

decisive_artifacts.artifact: Retained Amazon Q&A/review records for the ordered product
decisive_artifacts.question: Do the retained QAs/reviews for the ordered sweater show no report that its color fades after washing?
